current.text: He left the Lakers and joined Philadelphia. He is in the projected starting five with Maxey, Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown and Embiid.
Nick Nurse calls him an offense creator. His job is to set up everyone else, and he is reported to play point guard.
Josh expects a modest rise in his on-ball role, with maybe 8 assists per game instead of about 6.9. He does not expect a big change in how LeBron plays.
Usage is crowded in Philadelphia with Maxey, Embiid and Jaylen Brown. Experts expect the stars to cut into each other's shots, and his usage should be lower.
He is expected to sit some games and pace himself. The projection is about 65 games.
He has always wanted to play big minutes, and Nick Nurse, who gives his starters heavy minutes, may let him.
Yahoo lists him as questionable for rest.
Philadelphia has only 13 back-to-backs, which helps a little with his rest days. Three of them fall in the fantasy playoffs.
Philadelphia is projected to win about 51 to 52 games. The expert expects growing pains in October and November and load management for the stars.
He should be about a top 30 player per game.
Experts call a draft spot in the 40s too high. The 50s to 60s is fair value, and the 50s is fine if you are not focused on turnovers.
In auctions, do not pay more than 25 USD. He went for 22 USD in an expert mock.

durable.text: He is 41 and turns 42 this season.
He has arthritic toes and had sciatica last season.
His numbers are about the same every season. His scoring slowly drops, but he keeps the ball in his hands at a similar rate.
He gives guard-like assists from the forward spot, far above other forwards.
He commits many turnovers. This is his one weak category.

note: Experts cap him at 25 USD, which fits his Yahoo average cost of 20.8 USD and the 22 USD he cost in our league last season. Do not pay up to his Yahoo rank of 43, because the experts see fair value in the 50s to 60s. He fits best in punt TO builds, where his high assist total from a forward spot, his FG% on real volume and his scoring count fully and his 2.9 turnovers do not hurt. Early in the season, check whether he really plays point guard and gets near 8 assists, how often he rests (he is listed questionable for rest now), and how the shots are split with Maxey, Embiid and Brown.
